name: Honda CA95 Benly 150
engine: 154 cc air-cooled overhead-cam twin, one carb, four-speed
intro: The small Dream. A pressed-steel frame, a leading-link fork and an enclosed chain.

L: The leading-link fork pivots on bushings. Check for play and grease it before you trust the steering.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
